# Cross country movers


Are you looking for cross country movers? Some people think its best to get cheap movers but I disagree.  You know whats overrated? Cheap movers. These guys make lots of promises but maybe don't deliver. You want to know you are in good hands. That's why its best to pick a top rated moving company. Reliable long distance movers are licensed by the Department of Transportation. They follow OSHA rules. They are bonded and insured. It's important to find a cross country mover who does the job well.

There are more signs that you are working with one of the best moving companies. Do they spend lots of time and listen to what you say. If the movers will say no to you this is very good. Movers who say yes to everything shouldn't be trusted.



## long distance movers
 You can know that they are legitimate based on a few things. Do they talk the talk? Or do they just walk the walk. They will ask you good questions about what items you need to ship. They will want to know what floor you are on. They will ask if you are in a house or an apartment. They will tell you how long the delivery will take. They will explain exactly what is included. Also they will make sure you know what's not included.

## moving company
Movers will take an inventory of what you need to have shipped. Then they will give you an estimate of how much space your things take up on a truck. Responsible long distance movers will always overestimate how much stuff you have. Movers who have low prices may cost you a lot of money later. Watch out for lowball quotes from shady movers. Shady moving scams happen when movers tell you very low prices and then charge a lot of money. This can happen to anyone.  It happens to hundreds of people a day. You want to get a good deal and the best deal is a real deal.
